observable: per fresh connection: each master frame of connection start (final handshake ACK, first request)
received on dev9 and not emitted toward the relay, from the master NIC capture and the egress copies
of the existing relay-leg mirror; any master retransmission of the first request
classification: as E2_first_request in DESIGN.json, by frame: handshake ACK or first request
mechanism: source findings at fb5ce81b1: busy_t sends a READ to busy_drop while N holds its single work cell
(an ACK has a retry path), and a late handshake ACK with owner 0xd/0xe can take the first_event
default NoAction and then the abort path. With timing and padding on, connection start runs the timed
path; the existing E2 block ran the off arm, with T and padding off
falsifier: any master frame received on dev9 at connection start and not emitted toward the relay; if none is
seen, report 0 of 32 with no location, never an unconditional loss-free claim
reporting: k of 32 per frame kind, beside the c72 off-arm E2 result (diag_mirror_d3/SUMMARY.md)
interpretation_limits: The mirror is used for packet presence and content only; its timing equivalence was not established.
Diagnostic-build evidence stays labelled apart from c72 candidate evidence.
32 connections are a bounded diagnostic, not a rate estimate.
